_meta.note: Third Sunday of Great Lent — Veneration of the Holy Cross (Liturgy of St. Basil the Great, Tone 7)

commemorations.title: Third Sunday of Great Lent — Veneration of the Holy Cross

beatitudes._note: 6 dedicated resurrectional Beatitudes (Octoechos Tone 7 "Blesseds", NOT the canon) + 4 from Triodion Cross Canon Ode 6, Tone 1 (Canon of St. Theodore the Studite, SVS Lenten Triodion p. 342). The Octoechos set is kept in sync with octoechos.json tone7.sunday.liturgy.beatitudes.

troparia.label: Resurrectional (Octoechos Tone 7)
troparia.text: The fruit which slew me was beautiful and good to eat; but Christ is the Tree of life, and eating of Him I do not die, but cry out with the thief: Remember me, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

troparia.label: Resurrectional (Octoechos Tone 7)
troparia.text: O Compassionate One, Who wast lifted up upon the Cross, Thou hast erased the record of Adam’s ancient sin, and hast saved the whole human race from deception. Wherefore, we hymn Thee, O Lord and Benefactor.

troparia.label: Resurrectional (Octoechos Tone 7)
troparia.text: Thou didst nail our sins to the Cross, O compassionate Christ, and by Thy death Thou didst slay death, O Thou who didst raise up the dead from among the dead. Wherefore, we worship Thy holy resurrection.

troparia.label: Resurrectional (Octoechos Tone 7)
troparia.text: The serpent once poured its venom into the ears of Eve; but on the tree of the Cross, Christ poured forth the sweetness of life upon the world. Wherefore, we cry out: Remember us, O Lord, in Thy Kingdom!

troparia.label: Resurrectional (Octoechos Tone 7)
troparia.text: Thou wast laid in the tomb as one dead, O Christ, Thou Life of all; and Thou didst break down the gates of hades; and having risen again in glory on the third day as One mighty, Thou hast illumined all. Glory to Thine arising!

troparia.label: Resurrectional (Octoechos Tone 7)
troparia.text: Having risen from the dead on the third day, the Lord bestowed His peace upon His disciples; and having blessed them, He sent them forth saying: Lead all into My Kingdom!

troparia.label: Triodion, Ode 6, Tone 1
troparia.text: Thou hast crushed death, O Christ, and risen as a mighty King; Thou hast recalled us from the depths of hell, and brought us up to the land of immortality, granting us the joy of the Kingdom of Heaven.

troparia.label: Triodion, Ode 6, Tone 1
troparia.text: O ye faithful, let us cry aloud with joy and sing triumphantly to God, as we greet the Cross of the Lord; for it is a fountain of holiness to all the world.

troparia.label: Triodion, Ode 6, Tone 1, Trinitarian (at Glory)
troparia.text: I praise the Unity in three Persons and the Trinity worshipped in one Nature, the Triune God, threefold Light, Father, Son and Holy Spirit.

troparia.label: Triodion, Ode 6, Tone 1, Theotokion (at Both now)
troparia.text: O Ewe free from blemish, the greatest wonder of all wonders was revealed in thee; for thou hast borne the Lamb that takes away the sin of the world. Entreat Him fervently for those who sing thy praises.

entranceHymn.text: Come, let us worship and fall down before Christ. O Son of God, who art risen from the dead, save us who sing to Thee: Alleluia!

troparia.text: By Thy Cross Thou didst destroy death. To the thief Thou didst open Paradise. For the Myrrhbearers Thou didst change weeping into joy, and Thou didst command Thy disciples, O Christ God, to proclaim that Thou art risen, granting the world great mercy.
O Lord, save Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance! Grant victories to the Orthodox Christians over their adversaries; and by virtue of Thy Cross, preserve Thy habitation!

kontakia.connector: Glory to the Father, and to the Son, and to the Holy Spirit, now and ever, and unto ages of ages. Amen.
kontakia.text: Now the flaming sword no longer guards the gates of Eden; it has been mysteriously quenched by the wood of the Cross. The sting of death and the victory of hell have been vanquished; for Thou, O my Savior, hast come and cried to those in hell: "Enter again into Paradise!"

trisagion.text: Before Thy Cross, we bow down in worship, O Master, and Thy holy Resurrection we glorify.

prokeimenon.label: Triodion, Tone 6:
prokeimenon.refrain: O Lord, save Thy people, and bless Thine inheritance.
prokeimenon.verse: To Thee, O Lord, will I call. O my God, be not silent to me.

alleluia.label: Triodion, Tone 8:
verses: Remember Thy congregation which Thou hast purchased of old.
God is our King before the ages; He has worked salvation in the midst of the earth.

communionHymn.label: Triodion:
communionHymn.text: The light of Thy countenance has shone on us, O Lord. Alleluia, Alleluia, Alleluia!

saints: the Veneration of the Precious and Life-Giving Cross
